description: List published article summaries, newest publication first, optionally filtered by topic and format. Returns page, total_items, total_pages and items with slugs, canonical URLs, excerpts and dates. Defaults to page 1 with 10 records; use search for a question or keywords, then get_article for full text.

format.description: Match this article format exactly. Omit for all formats; combines with topic.

limit.description: Records per page, from 1 to 20 (default 10). Use page to continue; total_items and total_pages describe all matches.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1, maximum 500). Keep filters and limit unchanged while paging; stop at total_pages. A page beyond the results returns an empty items array.

topic.description: Match this editorial topic exactly. Omit for all topics; combines with format.

name: list_articles
title: List articles
